name: Peter Fraser
bio: Peter Fraser (also Frazer or Frazier) opened his bar in Medora in April 1886. In June he left for Rapid City with others, and in July his wife left to join him there.
mentions: Mose. Rider and Pete. Frazier opened their bars this morning. The former in the addition to the drug store and the latter in Mrs. Malloy's hotel. Gill. Kennedy will follow suit in a few days
Sam. Day, Nelson Michaelson, Peter Fraser and "Cook Nels," started for Rapid City this morning. They all expect to return during the summer.
Mrs. Peter Frazer left Monday for Rapid City to join her husband there.
